card.architecture: Photanima 2B photographic Anima finetune (Qwen3-0.6B encoder, Qwen-Image VAE), whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through Photanima using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn as a photograph. The de-turbo'd build (~40 steps, er_sde, CFG ~4). Ideal for pushing an illustrated or off-model image toward candid photorealism while keeping its layout.
use_cases: redraw an illustration or render as a candid photograph, keeping composition
restore an off-model photo edit back to Photanima's realistic look
amateur-photo restyle (grain, natural skin, smartphone look)
card.pick_when: You want to redraw the WHOLE image (not a masked region) into a realistic photo, keeping the composition. Use Anima (redraw) instead when the target look is anime.

prompt.guidance: Describe the photo you want in plain, specific words (subject, setting, lighting, lens, mood); the quality/realism prefix is added automatically. Because it's photographic and aesthetic by default, don't pile on hype/quality words. Lower the redraw strength (denoise) to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let Photanima reinterpret more.
prompt.required_prefix: masterpiece, score_9, absurdres, best quality, highres, photo \(medium\), real life,
prompt.example: amateur smartphone photo of a young woman standing by a white van in a sunlit pine forest, dappled light, natural skin texture, visible grain, candid, medium shot
prompt.instructions:
This is the DE-TURBO'D Photanima on the redraw rails: ~40 steps, er_sde sampler, 'simple' scheduler, CFG ~4 -- NOT the Turbo few-step path.
Type the FULL photographic description; the quality/realism prefix ('masterpiece, score_9, absurdres, best quality, highres, photo \(medium\), real life,') is prepended AUTOMATICALLY -- do NOT type it.
Amateur/candid language helps realism (grain, natural skin texture, smartphone photo). Do NOT add further hype tags beyond the auto prefix -- the model is photographic by default and over-driving fries the image.
'Redraw strength' (denoise) controls how far the result drifts from the source: ~0.4-0.5 keeps the source's structure, ~0.7+ substantially reinvents it. The source is downscaled to Photanima's native ~1 MP bucket before the redraw.
do: Write a plain, specific photographic description (subject, setting, lighting, lens, mood)
Use amateur/candid photo language for realism (grain, natural skin, smartphone photo)
Let the app add the quality/realism prefix -- don't type it
Lower Redraw strength to keep the source composition; raise it to reinterpret more
dont: Pile on hype/quality tags beyond the auto prefix (it fries the image)
Use the Turbo settings (6-8 steps / CFG 1) -- this build is de-turbo'd
Expect a masked/local edit -- this redraws the WHOLE frame
prompt.negative_guidance: CFG ~4, so negatives work but keep them light (the model is aesthetic by default).

negative.note: Works at CFG ~4; keep it light -- aesthetic by default. Uses the shared baseline negative, like Photanima's generate path.

speed.note: ~40 steps at CFG 4 (de-turbo'd), scaled down by the redraw strength; same 2B architecture as Anima.
